name: Ambassador: cat representative (outer ring)
author: Steambirds Revive
description: Summoned by the Ambassador under 30% health (3 of them, the orange ufosaucermini). Fixed to the Ambassador's body 8 units from its center, it turns with it, facing the way it circles (faceForward: it flips when the boss turns the other way), shooting. No shield: while it lives, the inner ring and the Ambassador are shielded. Reconstruction from a video.
